title.en: Civil Aviation Authority of Singapore (Seletar Airport) Notification 2009

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。附表 1 篇以 900000+ 序号随同收录。

text.en: 1. This Notification may be cited as the Civil Aviation Authority of Singapore (Seletar Airport) Notification 2009 and shall come into operation on 1st July 2009.

2. The lands and waters in Singapore described in the Schedule, including all roads, buildings, installations, and equipment therein, are hereby declared to be an airport, known as Seletar Airport, for the purposes of the Act.

THE SCHEDULE
Paragraph 2
Seletar Airport
All that land and water containing an area of about 1,608,000 square metres within the limits that are the boundaries to Lot numbers 1003K, 1044V, 1045P, 1046T, 1047A, 4515A-PT, 4517N, 4519L-PT, 4991W, 5126W-PT, 5127V-PT, 5146T-PT, 5151K-PT, 5170X-PT and 5171L-PT of Mukim 20, and which is more particularly delineated in the Plan below.
[S 589/2018 wef 01/10/2018]
